publicationAudit.scope: Independent publication review reopens owned databases through the tested read-only oracle, recomputes scores and quantiles from retained rows, checks frozen input/log hashes and process absence; it does not replay live HTTP responses or grant capture/privacy/power/whole-product acceptance.

configurationAndLimits: Only authored text ingestion and keyword HTTP retrieval, using unmodified signed ARM64 executables. Not capture, natural speech, semantic model quality, GUI, battery, ingestion throughput parity, whole-product parity or an overall ranking.

Screenpipe default PII removal is explicitly disabled (--use-pii-removal=false) for exact raw-text admission; its pinned CLI default is true. Capture, semantic app context, telemetry and background PII workers are also disabled. OSwind ordinary JSON import builds local Apple embeddings unused by keyword queries. This is a deliberately restricted component configuration, not both full products at defaults.

14 shared query cases, five timed rounds each, one warmup pass each. Same Python HTTP client, alternating product order; timed full-body reads exclude JSON decoding/scoring. Both shipping response shapes, query semantics and result caching remain. Warm caches, repeated requests and uncontrolled host work preclude a cold or causal speed claim.

The workload contains authored labels plus deterministic filler, not a held-out natural desktop distribution. App-filtered cases remain explicitly excluded because Screenpipe public transcription ingestion cannot supply app identity; historical time scopes are also not compared.

At both sizes Screenpipe is faster on this observed warm HTTP component and has 70/70 expected result sets. OSwind has 65/70, with the correct first design note plus an extra mint-paint note on quiet mint; all positive first hits/recall and the absent control pass. Product semantics were not tuned to remove this difference.

Initial benchmark profiles allowed Metadata IPC and the stock CLI added 14 task-created Spotlight exclusions. Earlier broad no-settings-change assertions are withdrawn. Stronger final-run profiles deny Metadata IPC and test known endpoints before startup. Restoration of earlier task exclusions remains unverified; see setupSideEffect.

Historical failures, failed log-retention attempt, and later passing runs remain distinct. Native collector detach exit 16 on f9da0be remains unresolved; a later green stage does not establish its cause or a fix.
